question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unceremonious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Unceremonious** refers to something lacking formality, politeness, or proper observance of established customs or procedures. (**अनौपचारिक**)

 
 
• **Example**: After working for the company for many years, his departure was unexpectedly unceremonious.
